recognize_zh: 這是示意圖而非形態學影像：由具自我更新能力的 LT-HSC 經 ST-HSC、MPP，分岔為骨髓系共同前驅（CMP）與淋巴系共同前驅（CLP），再往下分化成各成熟血球，並標註對應的 CFU 名稱。
features: Stem cell tier: self-renewing long-term HSC gives rise to short-term HSC and multipotent progenitor (MPP)
MPP branches into common myeloid progenitor (CMP, corresponding to CFU-GEMM) and common lymphoid progenitor (CLP)
CMP splits into megakaryocyte-erythroid progenitor (MEP, CFU-ME) and granulocyte-macrophage progenitor (GMP)
MEP yields megakaryocytes/platelets (CFU-MK) and red cells (BFU-E, CFU-E); GMP yields mast cell/basophil, eosinophil, neutrophil and monocyte/macrophage (CFU-GM)
CLP yields B, T and NK cells
describe_en: This is a non-morphologic schematic of the classical hierarchical model of hematopoiesis. A self-renewing long-term hematopoietic stem cell gives rise to short-term stem cells and multipotent progenitors, which then bifurcate into common myeloid and common lymphoid progenitors. The myeloid branch divides into megakaryocyte-erythroid and granulocyte-macrophage progenitors that generate committed precursors and mature megakaryocytes/platelets, red cells, granulocytes, mast cells and monocytes, while the lymphoid branch produces B, T and NK cells. The diagram maps the in vitro colony-forming units (CFU-GEMM, CFU-ME, CFU-MK, BFU-E/CFU-E, CFU-GM) onto each progenitor stage; newer models suggest a more continuous, less strictly binary differentiation landscape.
